snippet.title: Promise Mascot Agency: TGAGWCAGA Trailer!
snippet.description:
Promise Mascot Agency was officially selected for The Game Awards For Games Who Can't Afford The Game Awards Showcase! ✨🏆

This mini-trailer was shown at the awards, thank you to all of you who showed up, it was lovely seeing you guys in the chat! We enjoyed seeing all the indie games that were shown, and we hope you did too.

Our open-world narrative adventure Promise Mascot Agency is coming to PC and consoles soon! We've got some exciting announcements planned, so keep an eye out for those on this channel!✨

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585830/Promise_Mascot_Agency/
